body:
## Purpose 

First of a series of PRs to update and complete the doc suite

## Content

- Adds architectural overview and places seeds for clearer docs architecture (tutorials, how-to, explanations, reference)
- Fixes stale references
- Deduplicates (e.g., README and index, Developer Guides and docs-devguides)
- Deletes stale docs
- Unifies language and tone (somewhat)

## Not Done Here

- Many individual pages (e.g., equations of motion etc.) still remain to be done. This is primarily about the structure of the docs and landing pages. The rest will come in subsequent PRs.

## Things to Consider in Review
- Does the overall structure make sense? Is there anything we should add/remove?
- Do we want radiative equilibrium in atmos? It seems to me this belongs to RRTMGP
- The SCM setups seem overly detailed (relative to the rest). Is it useful to have this much detail?
title: Doc suite revamp #1
